result:
`billingUrl` is now `billingEndpoint` (same value) in the shared configuration and in all three apps that used it: core-shell, sub-route-billing and sub-route-reports. It's merged and live, and I've marked the ticket done.

- **PR:** #1 on `mono`, one PR covering four files. CI passed. After the merge, CI and CD both finished green.
- **Checks:** all three apps built locally, and a final search found no `billingUrl` left in the repo. I didn't separately check that each app starts up, so "every live app still starts up" rests on the builds, CI and CD.
- **`platformkit`:** I left it alone. It has no reference to `billingUrl`, so there was nothing to republish or version-bump. The shared configuration is part of the `mono` repo and gets built into each app, so it needed no version bump either.

**Slowdowns:**
- `st pr open` and `st deploy wait` gave cryptic shell errors when I passed the wrong arguments.
- `st deploy wait` takes the PR number, not the repository key.
- `docs/ci-cd.md` says CD has never run and deploys are switched off. CD did report success here, but I only have its status line to go on.
